external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Bosch is one of the biggest original suppliers for automotive spare parts in the world. It is also one of the pioneers when it comes to car diagnostics and workshop supplies.

Reflecting the founder’s passion for design, CIFAM was originally spun off from the Metelli brand (in 1975). The two companies later merged again, but today CIFAM remains a manufacturer of reliable hydraulic components, brakes, and constant velocity joints for transmissions.

Dayco is a global leader in the research, design, manufacturing and distribution of essential engine products, drive systems and services for automobiles, trucks, construction, agriculture and industry.
Industrias Dolz is a Spanish producer of water pumps with more than 80 years of experience in the field, supplying cars, trucks and tractors.

Elring is a supplier for gaskets and sealants for engine repair. It is an o/e supplier for most of the German applications amongst others. The brand name “Elring – Das Original” has long since become a trademark for outstanding quality, safety, service, availability, and reliability.
Top Drive Srl was born from the experience of the Iannaccone family present on the market in the car accessories sector for over 60 years.

The European leader in brake shoes joined the Metelli Group in 2014, bringing with it the widest range of applications for Japan, Europe & Korea. The brand was the first to manufacturer 100% asbestos-free brake shoes.
